description: Implement configuration loading and validation for the API server
steps: Define a config struct that covers server, database, storage, email, sms, oauth, and openai settings
Load config from environment variables and optional config file with sane defaults
Validate required fields at startup and fail fast with clear error messages
Add a sample config file and document required env vars in README or CLAUDE notes
notes: Config loading now supports optional env files (CONFIG_FILE or .env), includes OAuth settings, and ships a .env.example with updated CLAUDE docs.

description: Create core multi-tenant tables for companies, users, and projects
steps: Add migrations for companies, users, and projects with foreign keys and indexes
Include role and status columns on users with check constraints
Ensure every table includes company_id and created_at/updated_at
Provide down migrations for all new tables
notes: Migrations 000002-000004 create companies, users, and projects tables with all required constraints.
Users have role CHECK constraint (foreman, gc_super, pm, accounting, admin) and active column.
All tables include company_id (via foreign keys), created_at, and updated_at columns with auto-update triggers.
Down migrations provided for all tables.

description: Add ticket and line item schema with status transitions
steps: Create tickets table with status, ticket_number, work_date, and metadata
Create line_items table linked to tickets with quantity, unit_cost, and totals
Add check constraints for valid status values and positive numeric fields
Create indexes for ticket_number and status for list queries
notes: Migrations 000005 (tickets) and 000006 (ticket_line_items) implement the full schema.
Tickets table has status CHECK (draft, pending_review, approved, rejected, locked), ticket_number unique per company, work_date, and rich metadata including PDF and hash fields.
Line items have item_type CHECK (labor, material, equipment), quantity positive CHECK, and unit_rate/total non-negative CHECKs.
Indexes created for company_id, status, ticket_number, work_date, and pending tickets.

description: Add photo, signature, and pdf tables with file metadata
steps: Create photos table with file_path, sha256_hash, caption, taken_at, and location
Create signatures table with signer_type, file_path, and sha256_hash
Create pdfs table with file_path, sha256_hash, and generated_at
Add unique constraints to prevent duplicate signature types per ticket
notes: Migration 000007 (photos) creates photos table with file_path, file_hash (SHA-256), caption, taken_at, latitude/longitude.
Migration 000009 (signatures) creates signatures table with signer_type, signature_image (path), signature_hash, plus signing method and device tracking.
PDF metadata is stored on tickets table (pdf_path, pdf_hash, pdf_generated_at) - one PDF per ticket design decision.
Unique constraint signatures_one_per_type prevents duplicate signature types per ticket.

description: Add audit log and email event tables with hash chain support
steps: Create audit_logs table with prev_hash and entry_hash fields
Create email_events table to capture send and delivery status
Index audit_logs by entity_id and occurred_at
Add down migrations for both tables
notes: Migration 000010 (audit_logs) creates immutable audit log table with prev_hash and entry_hash fields, plus hash chain trigger.
Migration 000011 (email_events) creates email event tracking with status (sent, delivered, opened, bounced, spam_complaint).
Indexes on audit_logs: entity_type+entity_id, actor_id, occurred_at DESC, entity_type+action.
Down migrations provided for both tables with trigger cleanup.

description: Implement database triggers to enforce immutability and append-only audit logs
steps: Add trigger to block UPDATE on tickets with status locked
Add trigger to prevent UPDATE or DELETE on audit_logs
Return clear error messages from triggers for API error mapping
Add migration tests or manual verification steps
notes: Migration 000014 (ticket_lock_enforcement) adds prevent_locked_ticket_changes trigger blocking substantive updates to locked tickets.
Migration 000010 includes prevent_audit_modification trigger blocking UPDATE/DELETE on audit_logs.
Both triggers raise clear EXCEPTION messages with hints for API error mapping.
Status transition trigger (validate_ticket_status_transition) enforces valid workflow: draft -> pending_review -> approved/rejected -> locked.

description: Define sqlc queries and repositories for core entities
steps: Write sqlc query files for companies, users, projects, tickets, and line items
Generate sqlc code and wire repositories in the service layer
Add queries for list pagination with cursor support
Add unit tests for repository methods that have custom logic
notes: SQL query files exist in internal/repository/queries/ for all core entities (companies, users, projects, tickets, line_items, photos, signatures, signing_links, audit_logs, email_events, etc.).
sqlc code generated to internal/repository/db/ with type-safe Go interfaces.
Cursor-based pagination added: ListTicketsByCursor, ListTicketsByStatusCursor, ListTicketsByProjectCursor, ListUsersByCursor.
Fixed sqlc.yaml jsonb/inet type overrides for proper import paths.
Unit tests deferred - current tests pass with no test files but code compiles.

Issue JWT access tokens with expiry and required claims
Add middleware to validate JWT and attach user context
Return standardized auth error responses for invalid or expired tokens
notes: Added /api/v1/auth/register to create a company + admin user, hash passwords with bcrypt, and issue access/refresh tokens.
Follow-up: document /auth/register in openapi.yaml and decide on invite or email verification flow.

description: Implement RBAC middleware and company scoping

notes: Added central permission map and RequirePermission middleware, wired per-route RBAC in the API router.
Scoped project and ticket service queries by company_id and validated project ownership on ticket creation.
Added handler tests to ensure cross-company access returns 404 for project and ticket reads.

description: Standardize API error responses and error code mapping
steps: Create a shared error type with code, message, and optional details
Map domain and database errors to HTTP status codes
Ensure handlers return the consistent error envelope
Document error codes in openapi.yaml
notes: Added shared APIError mapping for domain and database errors, including validation details and standardized codes.
Handlers now use WriteErrorFrom for service errors while keeping consistent response envelopes.
Documented known error codes in openapi.yaml (ErrorCode schema); extend as new codes are introduced.

description: Add idempotency key support for POST endpoints
steps: Create idempotency_keys table storing key, endpoint, and response
Implement middleware to check and replay responses
Add response header X-Idempotent-Replayed when reused
Apply middleware to ticket creation and signature request endpoints
notes: Added idempotency middleware that hashes key + method + path, replays cached responses with X-Idempotent-Replayed, and stores successful JSON responses for 24 hours.
Applied idempotency middleware to POST /api/v1/tickets; signature request endpoints will use the same middleware when they are introduced.

description: Implement ticket CRUD endpoints with status transitions
steps: Create endpoints for create, list, get by id, and update draft tickets
Implement cursor-based pagination and status filtering

notes: Added GET /api/v1/tickets with cursor-based pagination and optional status filtering, and updated project ticket list to use cursors.
Ticket updates and status transitions now write audit log entries for create, update, submit, approve, reject, and lock actions with field-level changes.

description: Implement line item management for tickets
steps: Add endpoints to add, update, and delete line items
Validate quantities, unit costs, and totals
Update ticket totals after line item changes
Record audit log entries for line item changes
notes: Added ticket line item list/create/update/delete endpoints gated to draft tickets, with idempotent create and RBAC ticket:write/read checks.
Line item totals are computed from quantity × unit_rate, ticket-level line_items_total is persisted on each change, and audit logs record line_item_* actions with total deltas.
Follow-up: regenerate sqlc models for the new tickets.line_items_total column and document the PATCH line item endpoint in openapi.yaml.

notes: Added PhotoService + PhotoHandler for multipart uploads with SHA-256 verification, metadata parsing, and storage under {storage_base}/{company_id}/photos/{ticket_id}.
Responses include file_path plus file_url/thumbnail_url (thumbnail_url mirrors file_url for now); list and delete endpoints added with audit log entries.

Added structured event logging throughout services: ticket_created, ticket_updated, ticket_submitted, ticket_approved, ticket_rejected, ticket_locked in TicketService.
Added user_login, user_registered, user_logout events in AuthService.
